title: Boli Maa Kya Huva Sakina Ko
body:
Boli maa kya huva Sakina ko
Ghash yeh kyun aagaya Sakina ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Kyun yeh khaamosh hogayee aakhir
Kisney kya kehdiya Sakina ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya khabar isko kya huva beta
Dekho Abid zaraa Sakina ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Haaye ghurbath mein chheen kar mujhse
Legayi kyun qazaa Sakina ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Na shikaayat hai ab tamaachoun ki
Na rasan ka gilaa Sakina ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Saath hi ab sayeed kay milkar
Royein ahle-aza Sakina ko
